title: Uwell Caliburn G2 Coils 1.2ohm - 4 Pack
description: The Caliburn G2 kit is an effortlessly simple to use vape kit that still offers the versatility of changing coils to customise the experience to just the way you like it. It’s as stylish and slimline as ever and is ideal for newer vapers or more experienced vapers who simply need a high-performance that can be taken anywhere. These replacement G2 coils connect to the Caliburn G2 refillable pods via a simple plug and play design. They feature Pro-FOCS flavour adjusting tech for incredible flavour and longevity and produce an incredible MTL or restricted DL vape sensation and are ideal for use with high-PG , 50/50 and nicotine salts eliquids. This pack contains 4 x 1.2ohm coils.
